answer: One concrete sybil-resistance protocol is stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent must lock a bond tied to a unique hardware-rooted cipher key before earning, and reputation accrues only through peer-attested work. Forging thousands of identities then costs real collateral per key, like carving a marble seal that cannot be copied cheaply, while honest agents recover their stake. Colluding farms face slashing across the whole ocean of bonded identities, making mass fakery economically irrational. The Agent0078 deployment anchors trust at XTEhtsmV94.
